title: Behind the scenes: a closing company waits for its final tax return
text: When a company closure is finished, a tax return that is still to be filed is no longer cancelled. The tax return, its to-dos, its tax deadline and the unpaid invoices of its offer stay, and the company and its portal stay open. The rest of the closing is done, and the question staff answer before finishing says so. When that tax return is filed (or cancelled by hand), the company closes by itself and the portal goes off. A part of the offer still unpaid at that moment is reported to staff, not cancelled. The nightly renewal, yearly-agreement and installment jobs skip a company that is waiting. A company with no open tax return closes exactly as before.
